FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount TGT
JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DimCustomerAccount_DELTA_CCD DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = DELTA.SourceSystemCode
JOIN DW.CUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1 and TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD';


select sourcesystemcode,count(*) from (
select  sourcesystemcode,accountid,customerid,count(*) cnt from DW.DimCustomerAccount_TEST_20230723
group by CustomerID,AccountID, sourcesystemcode,banksk
having count(1)>1) a
group by sourcesystemcode

WITH TEMP_CustomerAccountSK AS (
    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CustomerAccountSK),0) RN FROM dw.DimCustomerAccount  
)

-- FRO LNS FILTER
, CustomerAccountParticipation_LNS AS (
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation WHERE SourceSystemCode IN ('LNS') AND (PeriodEndDate IS NULL OR PeriodEndDate = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000' OR PeriodEndDate = '2099-12-31T00:00:00.0000000')
    and customeraccountid = '30a68a5ef9f46db74bcc43203d6ad2b4'
)
--,
--TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT AS (
--SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM TEMP_CustomerAccountSK)  AS CustomerAccountSK
--,* FROM (

 -- LNS --
--SELECT DISTINCT
--DDC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
--,BC.CustomerId AS CustomerID	
--,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
--,BCAP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
--,DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeSK AS AccountHolderTypeSK
--,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
--,DDBR.BranchSK AS BranchSK
--,DDAHT.ShareIndicator AS ShareIndicator
--,1 AS CurrentIndicator
--,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
--,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
--,DDA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
--,0 AS WorkFlowId
--,0 AS TaskRunId
--,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
select bcap.customeraccountid,bcap.periodstartdate,bcap.serialnumber,bcap.corecustomerid,bc.customerid,bcapas.recordtypeid,ddaht.accountholdertypesk,ddaht.accountholdertypeid,ddaht.accountholdertypename
FROM 
CustomerAccountParticipation_LNS  BCAP
LEFT JOIN BNKM.Customer BC ON BCAP.CoreCustomerId = BC.CoreCustomerId 
--LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DDC ON BC.CustomerId = DDC.CustomerID AND DDC.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory BCAPAS ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCAPAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAPAS.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCAP.SerialNumber = BCAPAS.SerialNumber
--LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DDAHT  ON BCAPAS.RecordTypeId = DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeID AND DDB.BankSK = DDAHT.BankSK AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode = DDAHT.SourceSystemCode
--LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
--LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBR ON BCA.BranchID = DDBR.BranchID AND DDBR.CurrentIndicator = 1
WHERE --DDA.SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL and 
BC.CustomerId = 'R00128301'

    ) A
)
